call_unit: logical calls including route, spawn, worker, review and continuation-control calls
continuation: After every actual verification, ask the pilot to continue or stop with public reason; retain prior artifacts and results; continuation starts a fresh pass under the SAME global budget. No separate pass-count limit.

envelope.input_tokens: Additional and unknown until request/provider accounting. If independently certified <=64000 per attempt, conditional prompt envelope <=38400000 for 600 attempts, and combined <=43315200. The current pilot does not enforce this 64000 premise. It is an estimate, not a new task token cap.

opening_pilot_observation: CLI max-calls counts attempts, defaults24 and rejects >24. task.json has no supported max_calls field. This sidecar and public task instruction state owner intent; current launcher does not consume this sidecar. Never report it as enforced.
sealed_material: briefs and READING are reader-only, never worker context; allowlist exact task inputs only.
stop_rule: Own stated substantive completion rule, concrete inability/tool/evidence blocker, or global logical-call ceiling; distinguish them and leave unresolved work visible.
